integrity: The proof derives the exact moment formula analytically and distinguishes finite exact checks from a universal theorem. No independent review or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only S2 and finite positive measures, integer complex dimensions >=2; other Schatten classes, general complex measures, and general operator norm are not classified; the 2023 disk article complete text was inaccessible.
title: Dimension-driven Hilbert–Schmidt phase transition for measure-induced Cesàro operators on Bergman balls
